Website.title: Website
Website.description: Represents a website being tracked by Neup.Analytics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Website entity.

domain.description: The domain name of the website.

Account.title: Account
Account.description: Represents a user account in Neup.Analytics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Account entity.

email.description: The email address of the account owner.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user being tracked, can be anonymous or authenticated.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Represents an event tracked on a website.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Event entity.

userId.description: Identifier for the user who triggered the event (can be anonymous).

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the event occurred.

properties.description: JSON string containing additional properties for the event.

Funnel.title: Funnel
Funnel.description: Represents a funnel defined for tracking user conversion.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Funnel entity.

steps.description: An array of event names representing the steps in the funnel.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: Represents a user session on a website.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Session entity.

userId.description: Identifier for the user associated with the session (can be anonymous).

startTime.description: The timestamp of when the session started.

endTime.description: The timestamp of when the session ended.

duration.description: The duration of the session in seconds.

UserAnalysis.title: UserAnalysis
UserAnalysis.description: Represents analyzed user data based on various factors.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserAnalysis entity.

userId.description: Identifier for the user being analyzed (can be anonymous).

locationGeo.description: Geographic location of the user based on IP address (if available).

device.description: Type of device used by the user (e.g., mobile, desktop).

Page.title: Page
Page.description: Represents the content of a webpage at a specific point in time for session replay.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Page entity.

site_id.description: Identifier for the site this page belongs to.

page_path.description: The URL path of the page.

recorded_on.description: The timestamp of when the page content was recorded.

content.description: The full HTML content of the page.

version.description: The version number of this page recording.

Interaction.title: Interaction
Interaction.description: Represents a user interaction session recorded on a page.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to align with Neup.Analytics' core features, focusing on scalability, security, and ease of debugging. It prioritizes 'Authorization Independence' by denormalizing relevant authorization data to avoid costly and complex `get()` calls in security rules. It employs 'Structural Segregation' by separating data with different access requirements into distinct collections, and uses consistent 'Access Modeling' patterns, primarily path-based ownership and membership maps. This approach enhances security, simplifies rule definitions, and supports efficient `list` operations (QAPs). Account and Website relationship is handled via subcollections. Each subcollection denormalizes necessary information from the parent to maintain authorization independence. Added 'interactions', 'pages', and 'users' collections to support session replay and live view functionality.
